activities.name: Copy Data from ADLS to DB

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    E.EmployeeID,
    E.EmployeeName,
    E.Gender,
    E.Salary,
    D.DepartmentID,
    D.DepartmentName,
    D.Location
FROM dbo.TBL_Employee E
INNER JOIN dbo.TBL_Department D
    ON E.DepartmentID = D.DepartmentID;
